description: This file defines the AccessPolicyProcessor class in Drupal, responsible for processing access policies into permissions for user accounts, including caching and cache context management.

classes.name: AccessPolicyProcessor
classes.description: Class responsible for processing access policies into permissions, managing cache contexts, and handling account switching during permission calculations.

methods.name: addAccessPolicy
methods.description: Adds an access policy to the processor.

methods.name: processAccessPolicies
methods.description: Processes access policies for a given account and scope, utilizing caching and handling account switching.

methods.name: getPersistentCacheContexts
methods.description: Retrieves persistent cache contexts for all policies within a specified scope.

methods.name: validateScope
methods.description: Validates if calculated permissions match a specific scope.

methods.name: needsPersistentCache
methods.description: Determines if persistent caching is required based on policies.
